plans.note: No liability-limitation heading in the outline, but section numbering skips 3, 4, 6, 9, 11 and everything after 12, so a cap may sit in an unlisted section; check text adjacent to the indemnity in sec-12 for a cap, consequential-damages waiver and mutuality.

Sec-12 (INDEMNITY) is the operative clause; test whether TrueLink indemnifies us for third-party IP and its own misconduct or whether the indemnity runs one way from Client, and whether our indemnity is kept narrow.

Restrictions on our business would most plausibly appear in sec-8 (Client covenants) or as a licence-scope restriction in sec-2; no non-compete heading appears, so likely absent unless sec-8 contains a field-of-use or competing-product covenant.
Check sec-2 for exclusive hosting/licence language and sec-8 for a covenant to use TrueLink as sole provider of Hosting Services; nothing in the outline signals exclusivity.
Any pricing MFN would sit in sec-5 (COMPENSATION); confirm direction — only an MFN obliging us to give TrueLink best terms is objectionable.
Employee non-solicits are often bundled with Client covenants (sec-8) or the confidentiality article (sec-10); no dedicated heading, so probably absent.

No term/termination heading in the supplied outline (numbering gaps at 3, 4, 6, 9, 11 and post-12); look for termination language embedded in sec-2 (licence term) or sec-5 (fees on termination) before concluding it is missing.
Auto-renewal and notice window would accompany the term provision, likely in an unlisted section; check sec-2 for term/renewal wording and sec-5 for renewal-term price uplifts.
Governing law/venue normally appears in the trailing miscellaneous sections, which are not in the supplied outline; no candidate id carries it, so treat as not locatable here pending the full text.
Assignment/change-of-control typically sits in the unlisted boilerplate; check sec-2 for any anti-assignment restriction on the licence grant that would bar affiliate transfer.

Sec-2 (LICENSE) plus the sec-1 definitions govern ownership of the site, content and Client data; confirm no assignment or licence-back of our marks, customer data or hosted content to TrueLink, and check sec-10 for data-use rights.
Sec-2 is the grant clause; test for revocability at will, territory/term limits, and whether affiliates and contractors may use the licensed materials as defined in sec-1.
Audit/inspection of Client usage or records would most likely appear in sec-8 (Client covenants) or as a fee-verification right in sec-5; no audit heading in the outline.
Check sec-5 for late fees or stipulated damages payable by Client and sec-7 (unsolicited commercial e-mail) for any per-message penalty or fixed charge imposed on us.

Sec-8 covers Client's warranties only; look for a corresponding TrueLink performance warranty on the Hosting Services in the unlisted sections and, if none exists, treat the vendor-side warranty as missing.
No insurance heading; sometimes tucked into the indemnity article (sec-12). TrueLink hosts our site and data, so an insurance obligation is expected — likely a gap.
Sec-5 (COMPENSATION) is the place for minimum fees, guaranteed volumes or take-or-pay; confirm whether any minimum monthly/annual commitment exists and whether an exit accompanies it.

Post-termination data return/migration assistance is not signalled in the outline; check sec-10 for return-or-destroy of Confidential Information (which is not a substitute for transition help) and any unlisted termination section.
